---
title: Signal Lanterns
motif: a four-note rising figure A-C-E-D that lands a step short of the octave, answered by a falling C-B-A
central_image: signal lights flicking from red to green a moment before the train reaches them
arc: [the motif alone over a pulse, the motif doubled and driven on the drop, the motif alone again as the train leaves the city]
title_rationale: the signals are the only thing in the scene that moves at the train's speed
---

## Notes

The motif's missing octave is the tension: the Build sections stop on the D and the Drop sections finally answer with the falling line. The Breakdown inverts the motif's contour. Nothing is sung; the lead synth carries the motif and the bass carries the root pulse.
